title: Regulated fast‑lane for catalog onboarding: stability & pinning guardrails for enterprise variants
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Create a dedicated, auditable "fast‑lane" for enterprise model onboarding that balances time-to-serve with increased stability guarantees. The lane applies to new model additions and variant requests (quantized variants, smaller/latency‑optimized forks) where customers request pinning or accelerated adoption. This ticket defines the intake rubric, automated scoring model, mandatory eval gates, rollout guardrails (shadow canaries, staged pins), and handoff playbooks for security/compliance review. Goal: reduce enterprise lead time to usable pinned variants by 40% while preventing regressions and reducing rollback incidents.
acceptance_criteria: 1) A documented intake rubric that outputs a numeric fast‑lane score (0-100) and a binary fast-lane eligibility decision. 2) Automated eval pipeline configured for the fast‑lane with at least: latency baseline, hallucination/regression checks (customer prompt set), privacy/leak tests, and quantization accuracy delta. 3) Rollout policy templated: shadow canary -> 10% pinned -> 50% -> full; automatic rollback triggers (quality delta > threshold, error rate > X). 4) Console UX: per-request annotation that indicates 'fast‑lane' status, expected SLA, and pin expiry. 5) Runbook and security signoff checklist completed and attached to intake flow. 6) Pilot with 2 enterprise customers and one internal product team completed and results recorded.
decision_matrix: Fast-lane score = weighted sum of: customer_priority (40%), regression_risk (30%), infra_compatibility (15%), legal/compliance_flag (25% negative), model_size_delta (10% negative if > threshold). Eligibility requires score >= 70 and no hard compliance flags. Weightings configurable via console feature flags.
workflow_steps: Define intake form fields and mapping to score buckets
Implement automated eval suite and integrate with existing CI/evals infra
Design rollout templates and rollback triggers in Console
Add metadata fields to catalog (fast_lane_eligible, pin_window, pilot_customer)
Complete security/compliance checklist and KMS key mapping for pinned variants
Run pilot, collect metrics, iterate on thresholds
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: overly permissive fast‑lane leads to regressions. Mitigation: hard compliance flags block eligibility; automated rollback triggers and mandatory shadowing for 72 hours. Risk: increased operational load for pinned variants. Mitigation: limit fast-lane to customers with committed reserved capacity or explicit SLA add-on; add autoscaling caps and circuit breakers.
metrics: Primary: time-from-request-to-pinned (days), pilot customer satisfaction (NPS-like), rollback incidents within 30d, token-cost delta. Secondary: eval pass rate, percent of candidate models flagged by security.
notes: We intentionally separate eligibility from rollout speed. A model can be eligible but require extended shadowing if eval thresholds are close to borders. Initial thresholds are conservative; plan to loosen after 2 successful pilots. Coordinate with Sales for explicit contract language about pin windows and version deprecation behavior.
